findings.title: Indexer mentions balance-diff based native transfer handling
findings.description: The configuration mentions balance-diff based transfer handling. That can be a valid design, but it should be reviewed if native ETH transfer log proposals remain active or considered.
evidence: Balance-diff marker found in configuration text.
findings.recommendation: Document whether native ETH transfers come from logs, balance diffs, traces, receipts, or a combined pipeline, and add replay tests for representative transfer cases.

findings.description: The configuration does not mention BALs or EIP-7928. Static config cannot prove whether the indexer is incompatible, but explorer and indexer teams should explicitly track BAL ingestion and monitoring assumptions.
evidence: No BAL/EIP-7928 marker found in configuration text.
findings.recommendation: Add fork-readiness metadata documenting whether BAL-related block data is ignored, stored, displayed, monitored, or replay-tested.
